articles.title: ‘No Entry for Minors’: Ticket Row Over Film Sparks Heated Scene at Lucknow Cinema
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A heated altercation broke out at a cinema hall in Lucknow after a man attempted to purchase tickets for his minor son to watch the film Dhurandhar 2. According to reports, theatre staff refused entry to the child, citing age restrictions based on the film’s certification.

body.html:
A heated altercation broke out at a cinema hall in Lucknow after a man attempted to purchase tickets for his minor son to watch the film Dhurandhar 2.

According to reports, theatre staff refused entry to the child, citing age restrictions based on the film’s certification. This led to an argument between the father and cinema employees, with voices raised and the situation drawing the attention of other moviegoers.

Witnesses said the dispute escalated briefly before cinema management reiterated that they were bound to enforce certification rules and could not permit minors to attend the screening.

Security personnel intervened and managed to defuse the situation without any injuries. Normal operations at the theatre resumed shortly afterwards.

Authorities have not confirmed whether any formal complaint has been filed in connection with the incident.

#Lucknow #CinemaHall #MovieRow #Dhurandhar2 #PublicDispute

articles.title: Beer, Triple Riding & No Helmets: Shocking Reckless Ride Caught on Bengaluru’s BTM Road
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a disturbing display of reckless behaviour, triple riding was observed on BTM Road in Bengaluru on Monday, with multiple traffic violations putting lives at serious risk.

body.html:
In a disturbing display of reckless behaviour, triple riding was observed on BTM Road in Bengaluru on Monday, with multiple traffic violations putting lives at serious risk.

According to eyewitness accounts, three youths were seen riding a two-wheeler without proper safety measures, with some not wearing helmets. Shockingly, one individual was holding a beer bottle while riding, while the pillion rider was openly consuming alcohol and making careless hand gestures in public.

Such actions not only violate traffic laws but also pose a grave danger to pedestrians, other motorists, and the riders themselves. Drinking and driving is a serious offence, and when combined with triple riding and lack of protective gear, the risk of a fatal accident increases significantly.

The incident has raised concerns over growing indiscipline among young riders, who appear to show little regard for road safety norms or legal consequences. Experts warn that such behaviour often leads to avoidable tragedies on busy city roads.

Citizens have called for strict enforcement and immediate action against those involved, stressing that public roads are shared spaces where negligence can have deadly consequences.

Authorities are expected to take note of the incident and initiate appropriate legal action. Meanwhile, the episode serves as a stark reminder that reckless stunts are not a sign of bravado but a serious threat to human life.

#Bengaluru #BTMRoad #RecklessDriving #TrafficViolation #RoadSafety

articles.title: Gorakhpur Conversion Row: 4 Held, ‘Sunday Prayer Meets’ Under Scanner; Bihar Link Suspected
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In Gorakhpur’s Gulriha police station area, police on Sunday arrested four individuals, including a mother and son, over allegations of attempting religious conversions inside a house.

body.html:
In Gorakhpur’s Gulriha police station area, police on Sunday arrested four individuals, including a mother and son, over allegations of attempting religious conversions inside a house.

The arrests were made after a written complaint by Sheetal Mishra, a resident of Surajkund under Gorakhnath police station limits. Based on the complaint, police registered an FIR under the Religious Conversion Act and initiated an investigation.

The accused have been identified as Amit Singh and his mother Rita Devi from Parwarpar village in Ramkola (Kushinagar), Kanhaiya Yadav from PPganj, and Vicky Kumar from Sarhari in the Gulriha area. All four were taken into custody on Sunday.

According to sources, weekly prayer meetings were being organised every Sunday in the Gulriha area, and a video of such a gathering has also gone viral on social media. It is alleged that people, particularly from backward sections, were being lured into conversion by offering money, benefits, and promises of rewards, including changing their names.

During the investigation, the name of a man identified as Wilson, reportedly from Bihar, has surfaced. Police suspect that the alleged activities were being carried out at his behest. He is said to have converted himself earlier and was encouraging others to do the same.

Locals had earlier raised concerns about such activities in areas including Jungle Ekla, Sarhari, Pipraich, PPganj, and around institutions like AYUSH University. However, police had not taken action earlier due to the absence of formal complaints.

Police officials said they are now probing the wider network by interrogating the accused and analysing their call detail records (CDRs). Efforts are underway to identify other associates involved in the alleged operation.

CO Gorakhnath Ravi Kumar Singh stated that a thorough investigation is in progress and assured that the entire network will be exposed.

#Gorakhpur #UPNews #ConversionCase #BreakingNews #ReligiousConversion

articles.title: Reel Turns Fatal: BJP Leader’s 15-Year-Old Son Dies in High-Speed Stunt Crash in Hubballi
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a tragic incident in Hubballi, a 15-year-old boy, identified as Nameesh Sangalad, lost his life while filming a social media reel involving a high-speed stunt with two vehicles.

body.html:
In a tragic incident in Hubballi, a 15-year-old boy, identified as Nameesh Sangalad, lost his life while filming a social media reel involving a high-speed stunt with two vehicles.

Nameesh, son of BJP leader Veerabhadrappa Sangalad, was riding a 2022-model electric two-wheeler when the accident occurred on Thursday evening between 4:30 pm and 4:45 pm in the Shejawadkar Layout area near Unkal. The stunt reportedly involved an Audi Q7 and the electric bike approaching each other at high speed and swerving at the last moment.

According to police, the Audi Q7—originally registered in Noida in 2013—was allegedly being driven by a minor in a negligent, zig-zag manner as part of the reel shoot. During the attempt, the driver lost control and crashed into the electric bike coming from the opposite direction.

Nameesh, a Class 9 student studying in Mysuru, had come to Hubballi to celebrate Ugadi with his family. He had gone out with friends when the group decided to film the stunt video on the outskirts of the city.

The teenager sustained severe head and leg injuries and died on the spot, as per the FIR.

Based on a complaint filed by his father, police have registered a case against the minor driver under Section 105 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita for culpable homicide not amounting to murder. Hubballi Police Commissioner N. Shashikumar stated that the accident occurred while attempting an “action brake reel,” where both vehicles approach at speed and brake suddenly.

Police further said the electric bike was registered in the name of Vinayak Miskin of Hubballi, while the Audi had been transferred from Noida to Dharwad in 2022 after a no-objection certificate was issued by the Noida RTO.

An investigation is underway to determine the full sequence of events and fix responsibility in the case.

#Karnataka #Hubballi #RoadAccident #ReelGoneWrong #BreakingNews

articles.title: Price Row Turns Brutal: PAC Jawans Accused of Beating Vegetable Vendors in Varanasi, Woman Critical
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident of alleged police brutality has come to light from Varanasi, where two PAC personnel reportedly assaulted a vegetable vendor and his wife following a dispute over vegetable prices. The incident occurred on Saturday evening in the Manduwadih police station area.

body.html:
A shocking incident of alleged police brutality has come to light from Varanasi, where two PAC personnel reportedly assaulted a vegetable vendor and his wife following a dispute over vegetable prices.

The incident occurred on Saturday evening in the Manduwadih police station area. According to reports, PAC jawan Ashutosh Kumar Singh and his companion had arrived in the local market to purchase vegetables. An argument broke out when the vendor, Radheshyam Bind (45), refused to lower the price.

Later, the accused allegedly returned with an iron rod and launched a violent attack on the vendor. Radheshyam was brutally beaten and soon fell unconscious, bleeding profusely. His wife, Geeta Bind (40), rushed to intervene and pleaded with the accused to spare her husband, even offering vegetables for free. However, the assault continued.

In a disturbing turn, Geeta was allegedly pushed to the ground and also attacked with rods and sticks. She reportedly lay over her unconscious husband in an attempt to shield him, but the accuse continued the assault, causing severe head and neck injuries. Both victims were left covered in blood.

As chaos unfolded, local residents gathered and intervened. Enraged by the incident, some people overpowered and assaulted the accused jawan, during which he also sustained injuries. Another youth was reportedly injured in the scuffle.

Police reached the spot and shifted the injured — the vendor, his wife, and the accused — to the emergency ward of the BHU Trauma Centre. Doctors have stated that Geeta Bind’s condition remains critical.

According to locals, the dispute stemmed from a disagreement over vegetable prices, and the accused returned later to carry out the attack. The incident has sparked outrage in the area, with residents expressing anger over the conduct of the personnel.

Manduwadih Police Inspector Vidya Shankar Shukla assured that strict action would be taken against the accuse, stating that a case would be registered and the accused sent to jail. ACP Rohaniya Sanjeev Sharma confirmed that all injured persons are undergoing treatment and an investigation is underway.

The victims’ family stated that the couple has three daughters, adding to concerns over their condition. Authorities are continuing their probe into the incident.

#Varanasi #UPNews #PoliceBrutality #ViralNews #BreakingNews

articles.title: AI Misuse Backfires: Youth Held for Viral Video ‘Humiliating’ Police in Gujarat
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a concerning case highlighting the misuse of artificial intelligence, a youth from Ambaji in Gujarat’s Banaskantha district has been detained for creating and circulating an AI-generated video that allegedly tarnished the image of the police.

body.html:
In a concerning case highlighting the misuse of artificial intelligence, a youth from Ambaji in Gujarat’s Banaskantha district has been detained for creating and circulating an AI-generated video that allegedly tarnished the image of the police.

According to officials, the video was uploaded on Instagram from the ID “kako.009”. It showed a युवक wearing a birthday crown and holding a sword, while three policemen in uniform were depicted kneeling with folded hands in front of him. A police vehicle was also visible in the clip. The video was accompanied by provocative text aimed at spreading fear.

The clip quickly went viral on social media, triggering outrage and raising concerns over the misuse of AI to create misleading and offensive content.

Acting swiftly, Ambaji police launched an investigation and identified the video as AI-generated. The accused was traced to Vikram Kharadi, who was subsequently detained by the police.

Officials stated that the youth was taken into custody, counselled about legal consequences, and made to apologise. Police also created and released an “after-before” video to raise awareness and caution others against such activities.

Authorities said the action serves as a strong warning to those misusing technology and social media to spread provocative or defamatory content. Police emphasised that strict legal action will be taken against individuals attempting to defame institutions or create panic using AI tools.

The incident underscores growing concerns around the unchecked use of artificial intelligence and its potential to distort reality, mislead the public, and harm reputations.

#Gujarat #Ambaji #AI #FakeVideo #SocialMediaMisuse

articles.title: Mob Justice in Sambhal: Policeman Thrashed After Car Hits Father, Child
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking case of mob violence has emerged from Sambhal in Uttar Pradesh, where a police constable was brutally assaulted by an angry crowd following a road accident that left a father and his five-year-old son injured. The incident took place around 10:30 a.m.

body.html:
A shocking case of mob violence has emerged from Sambhal in Uttar Pradesh, where a police constable was brutally assaulted by an angry crowd following a road accident that left a father and his five-year-old son injured.

The incident took place around 10:30 a.m. on Saturday near the Maulagadh culvert on Bahjoi Road under the Chandausi Kotwali area. According to police, Head Computer Constable Pawan Kumar was driving a car along with Constable Pintu Kumar, carrying official registers from Chandausi Tehsil to Bahjoi for duty.

During the journey, Pawan Kumar allegedly pressed the accelerator instead of the clutch, causing the vehicle to go out of control. The car hit Mangal (25), a resident of Station Road in Bareilly, and his five-year-old son Akash, who were standing by the roadside waiting for passengers, and then collided with an e-rickshaw.

The accident triggered outrage among locals, who dragged the constable out of the vehicle and assaulted him, tearing his clothes and repeatedly slapping and punching him. A video of the incident, now viral on social media, shows some individuals attempting to intervene, but the mob continued the attack.

Police personnel from Chandausi Kotwali rushed to the spot after receiving information and managed to rescue the constable. He was later sent for medical examination. Meanwhile, the injured father and son were admitted to a government hospital, where they are undergoing treatment.

In his statement, the constable said the accident occurred due to mistakenly pressing the accelerator instead of the clutch, leading to loss of control of the vehicle.

Based on a complaint filed by Pawan Kumar, police have registered a case against Karni Sena district president Bittu Thakur, e-rickshaw driver Suresh, Sudesh, and four to five unidentified individuals. One accused has been taken into custody, and further identification is underway using the viral video.

Station in-charge Anuj Tomar confirmed that legal action is being taken against those involved in the assault, and the investigation is ongoing.

#Sambhal #UttarPradesh #MobViolence #RoadAccident #PoliceAssault

articles.title: Prayagraj Horror: Wife Allegedly Strangled and Killed by Husband, 6-Year-Old Witnesses Brutal Crime
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A gruesome case of alleged domestic violence has emerged from Prayagraj district in Uttar Pradesh, where a man is accused of brutally murdering his wife following a late-night argument. The incident took place in Pattichit village under the Sarai Inayat police station limits.

body.html:
A gruesome case of alleged domestic violence has emerged from Prayagraj district in Uttar Pradesh, where a man is accused of brutally murdering his wife following a late-night argument.

The incident took place in Pattichit village under the Sarai Inayat police station limits. The accused, identified as Shailesh Kumar, allegedly killed his wife Sangeeta Devi (32) on Tuesday night. According to preliminary findings, a dispute between the couple escalated into violence, during which the accused reportedly strangled his wife and later attacked her with a sharp weapon. Blood stains were found across the room, indicating the severity of the assault.

The couple’s two sons, aged 12 and 6, were present during the incident. The younger child reportedly told police that he woke up during the night and saw his father strangling his mother, but was scolded and sent back to sleep.

The crime came to light on Wednesday morning when a neighbour arrived to call Sangeeta for work in the fields. After repeated calls went unanswered, the children came out crying. Upon entering the house, the neighbour found Sangeeta lying on the floor with severe head injuries.

Police reached the spot soon after receiving information and launched an investigation. A forensic team and dog squad were deployed to collect evidence.

According to DCP Ganganagar Kuldeep Singh Gunawat, the case prima facie appears to stem from a domestic dispute. Based on a complaint filed by the victim’s brother, a case has been registered against the accused, who has since been arrested and is being interrogated.

Police stated that the exact cause of death will be confirmed after the postmortem report. Further investigation is underway.

#Prayagraj #UttarPradesh #DomesticViolence #CrimeNews

articles.title: Caught on Camera: Gurukul Teacher Thrashes Student Brutally, Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident has surfaced from the Maharishi Sandipani Rashtriya Vedvidya Sansthan (Gurukul) in Ujjain, where a teacher allegedly thrashed a student with a stick inside the campus.

body.html:
A shocking incident has surfaced from the Maharishi Sandipani Rashtriya Vedvidya Sansthan (Gurukul) in Ujjain, where a teacher allegedly thrashed a student with a stick inside the campus.

According to reports, the incident took place in a room at the institution located on Chintamani Ganesh Mandir Road. The student was reportedly beaten for sleeping on another student’s bed. Despite the student screaming in pain, the teacher continued the assault.

The accused has been identified as Dattadas Shevde, who is posted at the Samved Ranayani branch and also serves as a warden. In the viral video, he can be seen questioning the student before repeatedly hitting him with a stick.

The incident was recorded by someone present in the room, and the video surfaced on Saturday, quickly spreading across social media.

Despite the video going viral, there has been no official response from the institute so far. Authorities could not be contacted due to the holiday.

The Gurukul is a residential institution run by the Government of India, providing Vedic education. Students from across the country reside on campus, where they follow a strict routine that includes waking up at Brahmamuhurta, performing Sandhyavandan, and adhering to disciplined practices under the supervision of wardens and teachers.

#Ujjain #Gurukul #ViralVideo #StudentAbuse #TeacherMisconduct

articles.title: Midnight Mayhem on Bengaluru Streets: Lamborghini Drift Stunt Sparks Police Action
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a shocking incident, a Lamborghini owner has been booked for performing a high-speed drifting stunt at the busy Anil Kumble Circle on MG Road in Bengaluru during the early hours, police said on Saturday. According to officials, the incident took place between 2 a.m.

body.html:
In a shocking incident, a Lamborghini owner has been booked for performing a high-speed drifting stunt at the busy Anil Kumble Circle on MG Road in Bengaluru during the early hours, police said on Saturday.

According to officials, the incident took place between 2 a.m. and 3 a.m., when the luxury car was seen drifting recklessly, effectively turning the major junction into a stunt zone and putting other road users at risk.

The act was captured on surveillance cameras and was also witnessed by several commuters present at the spot. Based on the vehicle’s registration number, Cubbon Park police have registered an FIR against the owner.

Taking serious note of the dangerous driving, police have booked a case under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) and the Motor Vehicles Act.

Authorities have launched an investigation to identify the person who was driving the vehicle at the time of the incident. Police are also verifying whether the registered owner was behind the wheel. Further action will be taken based on the findings.

Meanwhile, an 11-second video of the stunt has gone viral on social media, showing the car drifting at the junction as onlookers cheer before it speeds away.

#Bengaluru #MGroad #Lamborghini #RecklessDriving #RoadSafety
